answer: Cosignatures are collected in basalt, verified in atlas, and yarrow names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 22 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 7 hours of verification and 1 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
